stemMd: Diamond is very hard and has a high melting-related decomposition/sublimation temperature. Which structural feature explains these properties?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A lattice of sodium and chloride ions

options.label: B
options.textMd: Weak attractions between separate carbon dioxide molecules

options.label: C
options.textMd: Layers held together only by hydrogen bonds

options.label: D
options.textMd: An extended network of strong covalent bonds

options.label: E
options.textMd: Individual carbon atoms with no interactions

explanationMd: Each carbon is covalently connected into a three-dimensional network. Disrupting that structure requires breaking many strong bonds, unlike separating small molecules held by weak intermolecular forces.

distractorRationale.c: Diamond has a three-dimensional covalent network.
distractorRationale.e: Its properties arise from strong interactions.
distractorRationale.b: Diamond is not molecular carbon dioxide.
